name: High Kuotagha
tactics: Like Abalach-Re, a high kuotagha looks weak, decadent, and unarmed. Once an enemy draws near, the assassin’s body hardens, its claws extend, and its arm tendons detach from its biceps to form flexible bands.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Corded Victim
traits.details: The high kuotagha can score a critical hit against a creature grabbed by it on a roll of 18-20.

traits.name: Slippery Foe
traits.details: The high kuotagha gains a +4 bonus to all defenses while it has a creature grabbed.

powers.name: Flesh Garrote
powers.description: The high kuotagha sustains each of its grabs, and each creature it is grabbing takes 2d6 + 10 damage.

attacks.name: Attack
attacks.targets: one creature granting combat advantage to the high kuotagha

hit.description: damage, and the high kuotagha grabs the target. The target takes a -4 penalty to attempts to escape the grab.

Description.text: The high kuotagha sustains each of its grabs, and each creature it is grabbing takes 2d6 + 10 damage.

powers.name: Garrote Slide
powers.trigger: An attack targets the high kuotagha when it has a creature grabbed.

effect.description: The high kuotagha slides 1 square and simultaneously slides each creature it is grabbing to any unoccupied square adjacent to it.
